Package
Description
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework
Public JUnit framework API for creating worlds and synthetic players and asserting game state.
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.assertions
AssertJ-based assertion types for fluent validation of LightKeeper world, player, and menu state.
